cells.label: fact

items.text: Merrill discloses it pays Advisors a salary and incentive compensation based on revenues Merrill receives for providing Program Services and brokerage services; Advisors are credited with 'production credits' from a portion of the Merrill Lynch Fee and Sales Charges, plus credits for margin lending, cash swept to Bank Affiliates, and referrals for banking, lending and other financial services.
items.quote: We pay Advisors a salary and incentive compensation that is based on the revenues Merrill receives for making available and/or providing Program Services as well as for the brokerage services provided to clients with brokerage accounts. In general, an Advisor is credited in the form of "production credits" with a portion of the Merrill Lynch Fee paid and, for brokerage accounts, the Sales Charges received from securities transactions.

items.text: Merrill discloses that an Advisor earns compensation based on the revenue Merrill earns from the Merrill Lynch Fee, Sales Charges related to securities transactions in brokerage accounts, and referrals to Affiliates (including banking products or services).
items.quote: Your Advisor earns compensation based on the revenue that Merrill earns from the Merrill Lynch Fee paid by you in the Program and other revenue derived from certain, but not all, of the other fees and costs you incur... as well as from the revenue derived from the referrals to Affiliates (including referrals to an Affiliate for banking products or services).

items.text: Merrill discloses Advisors are eligible to receive a compensation award from an incentive program currently based on meeting growth targets from the prior year in new households and in assets and liabilities, and that an Advisor is subject to a reduction in their incentive compensation grid if they fail to achieve growth for two consecutive years.
items.quote: Advisors are eligible to receive a compensation award, payable over a defined period of time, from an incentive program that is currently based on meeting growth targets from the prior year in new households and in assets and liabilities. ... An Advisor is subject to a reduction in their incentive compensation grid if they fail to achieve growth for two consecutive years in the assets and liabilities component of the award.

items.text: Merrill discloses Advisors receive 'production credits' toward their compensation formula based on the Merrill Lynch Fee paid, and that policies result in Advisors receiving fewer production credits (by 10% or more) if the weighted average Merrill Lynch Fee Rates are below rate levels for specific wealth asset tiers.
items.quote: In general, Advisors receive "production credits" toward their compensation formula based on the amount of the Merrill Lynch Fee that you pay for your Account. Merrill's policies result in Advisors receiving fewer production credits (by 10% or more) if the weighted average Merrill Lynch Fee Rates for a client's Accounts and for the Accounts that are part of the Household is lower than the rate levels for specific wealth asset tiers that Merrill establishes.

items.text: Merrill discloses the higher the Merrill Lynch Fee Rate a client agrees to, the more the Advisor earns in production credits, and the more production credits an Advisor generates, the higher the Advisor's incentive compensation.
items.quote: The higher the Merrill Lynch Fee Rate you agree to, the more your Advisor earns in production credits. The more overall production credits that an Advisor generates, the higher the Advisor's incentive compensation.

items.text: Merrill discloses that Advisors who join from other firms generally receive recruitment payments, which may take forms including salary guarantees, upfront awards and deferred payments or recruitment loans, generally based to a large extent on the size of the business at their prior firm, and conditioned on total assets in accounts they service at Merrill.
items.quote: Advisors who join Merrill from other firms generally receive payments in connection with that move. These payments may take various forms, including salary guarantees, upfront awards and various forms of compensation contingent on continued employment (e.g., deferred payments, recruitment loans). The amount paid to Advisors under these arrangements is generally based to a large extent on the size of the business at their prior firm.

items.text: Merrill discloses elements of field management compensation are based on revenues to Merrill and on the financial advisors they manage meeting strategic goals, and that management personnel receive incentive compensation based on factors including the profitability of Merrill and BofA Corp.
items.quote: Elements of our field management compensation are based on revenues to Merrill and based on the financial advisors whom they manage meeting strategic goals set for the year... Management personnel of Merrill and other employees of Merrill, MAA and their Affiliates receive incentive compensation based on a number of factors including the profitability of Merrill and BofA Corp.

items.text: Merrill's Advisor Development Program recruiting materials state the role offers a base salary and unlimited earning potential.
items.quote: Base salary and unlimited earning potential

items.text: Merrill discloses that for Program Accounts, Advisors are compensated based on the Merrill Lynch Fee charged on the Account, and that Advisors do not receive additional compensation as a result of advisory client assets held in the Cash Sweep Program.
items.quote: For Program Accounts, Advisors are compensated based on the Merrill Lynch Fee charged on the Account which is based on the agreed-upon Merrill Lynch Fee Rate and the value of the assets in the Account... Advisors do not receive additional compensation as a result of advisory client assets held in the Cash Sweep Program.

items.text: Merrill discloses it calculates the compensation paid to its Advisors on the same basis for all Program assets without regard to the amount of any Additional AI Compensation or revenue Merrill receives from third-party firms.
items.quote: we... calculat[e] the compensation paid to our Advisors on the same basis for all Program assets and without regard to the amount of any Additional AI Compensation Merrill or our Affiliates receive in connection with the Investments.

cells.reason: The passages contain extensive firm disclosure of Merrill's advisor compensation structure, including salary plus production-credit-based incentive compensation, growth-target awards, recruitment payments and field management compensation, so these are facts.
